mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% signals accommodative monetary policy that compresses equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS < 0.5% for 3 consecutive months but 20-day forward returns are negative in >60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 9.5% indicates severe labor market distress that triggers short-term equity sell-offs, producing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: UNRATE > 9.5% but 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strengthening consumer demand that drives corporate earnings, producing positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: HOUST and RSAFS both rise >1.5% MoM but 60-day forward returns are negative in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining industrial production (INDPRO) during recessions signals manufacturing weakness that deteriorates corporate profits, producing negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO falls for 3 consecutive months (recession regime) but 20-day forward returns are positive in >45% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: CPIAUCSL exceeding 3.0% year-over-year triggers inflation fears that prompt monetary tightening expectations, causing negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: CPIAUCSL > 3.0% YoY but 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Declining non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) indicates weakening labor market conditions that correlate with negative 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: PAYEMS falls for 3 consecutive months but 60-day forward returns are positive in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In post-recession recovery, real GDP growth (GDPC1) exceeding 0.5% QoQ signals economic improvement that drives positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: GDPC1 growth >0.5% QoQ in post-recession recovery but 20-day forward returns are negative in >40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and real GDP (GDPC1) indicates deepening economic contraction that causes negative 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: INDPRO and GDPC1 both fall for 2 consecutive months but 5-day forward returns are positive in >55% of cases.
